clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec directs the Forsaken garrison in Silverpine Forest. From this crypt, he oversees defense against threats such as the Rot Hide gnolls and investigates scouts who have gone missing across the zone.

High Executor Hadrec directs Forsaken military operations from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Tirisfal Glades is secure under the Dark Lady’s forces, but Silverpine faces hostile Dalaran mages, feral worgen, and encroaching gnolls. Hadrec must strengthen Forsaken control and suppress threats to Undercity authority south of the capital.

The Rot Hide gnolls and Fenris Isle occupy much of Hadrec’s attention. Tainted by undeath, the beasts have overrun the Dead Fields and Lake Lordamere’s shores, threatening Forsaken patrols. Hadrec sends agents to search the ruined ferries and farmsteads for clues, learn what empowers the gnolls, and prepare a strike against their island stronghold.
